headline_stat.name: Fraction of pyramidal cells significantly theta-entrained

stated_limitation: The work uses realistic synthetic hippocampal data that follows the characteristics of actual recordings from rodent navigation tasks.

justification.dataset: No dataset was selected or loaded; DANDI:000059 and DANDI:000003 are cited only as datasets the method could in principle be applied to.
justification.handling: All data are generated by generate_hippocampal_data() with a fixed seed, an automatic 0 under the synthetic-data rule.
justification.analysis: Phase precession is quantified as the range of np.unwrap applied to unsorted spike phases rather than a circular-linear slope, entrainment uses an ad hoc 1 - circstd/pi with no Rayleigh test or shuffle null, and linear polyfit is applied to circular data.
justification.correctness: The claimed 8/8 entrainment fraction is above the 0.45-0.95 preregistered range and the 422 degree mean precession exceeds a full cycle, and the committed notebook prose reports 0.78 and 145 degrees, numbers that appear nowhere in the analysis output.
justification.figures: Figure 4 shows mostly positive fitted slopes and Figure 3 shows near-uniform phase distributions, neither of which supports the precession and phase-locking the text claims, and Figure 2 contains a blank axis.
justification.honesty: The Results section and final summary call simulated units 'recorded place cells' showing 'robust phase locking' and 'negative slopes in most cases' when the run's own figures show near-uniform phases and mostly positive slopes.
